evidence_criteria: Clear task success, information found, no obvious confusion, smooth navigation, confidence in answer.
Small hesitation, slight search effort, minor confusion resolved quickly, task still completed without major issue.
Repeated searching, unclear navigation, uncertainty, long effort, partial success, or workaround; not necessarily total failure.
Could not complete task, gave up, got stuck, could not find key information, clear accessibility barrier, or major workaround.
Transcript incomplete, task boundary unclear, speech mixed with screen-reader/page audio, or no aligned task evidence.
validation_use: Excluded from error metrics; retained for auditability.
